coverage_interpretation: Depth-reference coverage includes source-selected inverse-transport sections and core context. It does not imply complete lower boundaries, full thickness fields, seasonal envelopes or volumes. Cruise/decade groups remain distinct. Local zero-flow boundaries from a processed climatology do not establish instantaneous or whole-route thickness. An upper-component depth reference does not cover the deep component; independent sections do not inherit unrelated width observations. Strict upper bounds are not point estimates. Overlapping mooring studies and model/observational cases remain distinct, without constructing numerical uncertainty or annual ranges. Deep domains with unspecified seafloor endpoints do not establish numerical thickness; spatially distinct summaries and current components remain separate.
